# Contributing to BubuStack Helm Charts

Thank you for considering a contribution — your help keeps the BubuStack Helm charts healthy for everyone.

This guide explains how we work, from filing issues to sending patches.

## Important: charts are auto-generated

Charts in `charts/` are **generated by automation** from the source operator repositories (`bobrapet`, `bobravoz-grpc`). Do not edit chart templates or generated values directly in this repo — changes will be overwritten on the next sync.

To change chart behavior:
1. Modify the source in the operator repo (`hack/charts/` or Kustomize manifests)
2. The `sync-helm-chart` job in the operator's release workflow will open a PR here automatically

## What you CAN contribute here

- Chart value overrides and documentation improvements
- CI workflow improvements (`publish-charts.yml`)
- Community health files (README, SUPPORT, SECURITY, etc.)
- Helm repo configuration and publishing fixes

## How Can I Contribute?

### Reporting Bugs

- Search for an existing report under [Issues](https://github.com/bubustack/helm-charts/issues).
- If nothing matches, [open a new issue](https://github.com/bubustack/helm-charts/issues/new) with a clear description, reproduction steps, and both observed and expected behaviour.
- Include: chart name, chart version, Helm version, Kubernetes version, `values.yaml` overrides used.

### Suggesting Enhancements

- Start a thread in [Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/bubustack/discussions) or file a feature request issue.
- If the change affects the operator itself (not just chart packaging), file it in the [operator repo](https://github.com/bubustack/bobrapet/issues).

### Pull Requests

- Fork the repository and branch from `main`.
- Keep changes focused.
- Open the PR with a summary and testing evidence.

### Commit Message Conventions

We use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) so releases and change logs stay automated.

Examples:
- `fix: correct service port in bobrapet chart`
- `docs: update installation instructions`
- `chore: bump chart-releaser action version`

### Code of Conduct

Participation in this project is governed by the
[Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). By participating,
you are expected to uphold this code. Please report unacceptable behavior to
[conduct@bubustack.com](mailto:conduct@bubustack.com).
